description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Disputes between H. K. N. S. Herath Palatuwa and Other Part Sri Lanka Transport Board Colombo 05
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act, including the revocation of a previous arbitration appointment and the appointment of a new arbitrator to settle industrial disputes. The content focuses on statutory instruments and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
